Jon - Sales: Hey team — Acme wants to run a 2-week POC starting next Wed. They need a Dedicated pool (8x A100 equiv) + temporary surge headroom for demo spikes. Also need ephemeral API keys for their app team and VPC peering for logs/metrics. Can we provision today? cc @Tess (SE) @Alex (Infra)

Tess (SE): We can handle the dedicated pool + surge policy. For POCs we typically grant a short burst window (48h) and ephemeral credentials. Quick questions: do they want autoscaling (preferred) or a fixed-reserve? For autoscale I suggest: min_replicas: 2, max_replicas: 12, target_inflight: 200, burst_headroom: 40%. Sample policy below — keep in mind model selection impacts p99 latency.

```
# autoscale example (POC)
min_replicas: 2
max_replicas: 12
target_rps_per_replica: 400
burst_headroom_percent: 40
scale_cooldown_sec: 60
priority: poc-acme-demo
```

Alex (Infra): Sounds fine. I'll need: billing owner contact, ACME VPC CIDR for peering, and KMS ARN for encrypted logs. Also confirm who signs the short LOI so we can apply temporary credits. I can create the pool once I have that and an OK from finance.

Maria (PM): For pricing — we can offer POC credits: up to $5k usage at 50% discount; anything above falls to standard on-demand. Finance sign-off required to attach credits to the tenant.

Jon - Sales: Billing owner is acme-billing@acme.com. VPC CIDR: 10.20.0.0/16. KMS ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef12-3456. They asked for least-priv privilege — ephemeral API key scoped to generate:write + embeddings:read with TTL ~72h. Also they requested an SLA note for the demo: p99 < 300ms if using quantized medium model. Is that feasible?

Tess (SE): Ephemeral key scoped exactly as requested is fine. TTL 72h works. Regarding p99 — depends on model and prompt sizes; for short prompts quantized gpt-medium variant can usually meet p99 < 300ms within a Dedicated pool with warm KV cache and target RPS settings. We'll recommend: warmup with synthetic traffic 30m pre-demo, enable prefix/KV caching, and set fallback to a smaller hosted model if pool saturates.

infra-bot: Ticket #INF-2345 created: dedicate-pool-acme-poc. Priority: high. Assigned: Alex (Infra). ETA pool provisioning after approvals: ~4 hours.

Alex (Infra): Created provisional pool resource rp-ACME-2026 (status: provisioning). I also pre-reserved a temporary surge buffer of 4 GPUs for up to 48h pending LOI and finance sign-off. Endpoint (internal): rp-acme.internal.redwood.net. I placed an ephemeral API key in the vault and shared access with Tess and Jon. Jon — please upload the signed LOI and CC finance so we can attach credits.

Jon - Sales: LOI signed and uploaded at 1819990200. Also confirming they want TLS client cert for VPC peering. Who handles cert issuance?

Tess (SE): Ops handles certs for peering. Alex — please open the cert request and start the VPN/TLS negotiation. Also here's a quick smoke test curl for the team to validate connectivity once the pool is ready:

```
# smoke test
curl -X POST https://rp-acme.internal.redwood.net/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $EPHEMERAL_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-medium-quant","input":"hello"}'
```

Alex (Infra): Cert request opened (CERT-778). Pool warm-up (pulling weights + kernel selection) started. I'll post logs to the ticket. Expected pool ready time: ~2.5 hours from now, but surge buffer already reserved. If finance approves credits I'll mark the pool as active for the tenant.

Maria (PM): Noted — finance looped in. I'll expedite the credit approval; target to approve within 90m. Also will add the POC discount note to the invoice metadata.

Jon - Sales: Great — thanks everyone. :thumbsup: Ping me if anything blocks. I'll run the demo team through the smoke test once Alex confirms pool ready.

Alex (Infra): Will update ticket and add a post-provision checklist (VPC peering, KMS policy, ephemeral key TTL).
